basic_info.description: Discover an exceptional investment opportunity with this delightful 3-unit building, ideally situated just steps away from the lively and vibrant Castro Street. This property features two currently occupied units, each thoughtfully designed with 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 well-appointed bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy dining room, and a bright living room perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The third unit, delivered vacant, offers 1 comfortable bedroom, 1 modern bathroom, a functional kitchen, and a welcoming living room, providing flexibility for immediate occupancy or customization. All three units share access to a beautifully maintained, lovely serene garden and outdoor retreat for tenants to enjoy amidst the urban bustle. Located in a sought-after neighborhood, this building is conveniently close to excellent public transportation options, trendy shops, top-notch restaurants, charming cafes, and lively bars, ensuring a dynamic lifestyle for residents. Whether you're an investor seeking steady rental income or a buyer looking to create a personalized home base, this property blends charm, convenience, and potential in one of the city's most iconic areas.
